# ctables/alloc

> Helper: the heap. `__pk_alloc(n)` returns `n` zeroed bytes, 8-aligned.

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/alloc.pkg)

  A bump allocator over 64 MB blocks from `mmap`, as in bintables; memory
  is never freed. Running out calls `__pk_panic_oom`.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
@panic
```

Includes: [ctables/panic](panic.md)

## Support code (once per program)

```nasm
static W __pk_heap, __pk_heap_end;
static W __pk_alloc(W n) {
n = (n + 7) & -8;
if (__pk_heap + n > __pk_heap_end) {
W size = n > 67108864 ? n : 67108864;
void *p = mmap(0, size, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
if (p == MAP_FAILED) __pk_panic_oom();
__pk_heap = (W)p;
__pk_heap_end = (W)p + size;
}
W r = __pk_heap;
__pk_heap += n;
return r;
}
```
